# WattsBooked

> WattsBooked is an all-in-one AI-powered growth platform built exclusively for electricians. It replaces disconnected tools with a single system covering CRM, booking, Voice AI, Conversation AI, SMS/email marketing, reputation management, memberships, analytics, and payments.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://wattsbooked.com/): Platform overview and value proposition
- [Features](https://wattsbooked.com/features.html): Full feature breakdown — Voice AI, Conversation AI, CRM, automation, analytics, membership
- [Answering Service](https://wattsbooked.com/answering-service.html): The AI answering service for electricians — answers every call 24/7, flags emergencies, books the job on your calendar, and logs the lead in your CRM
- [Pricing](https://wattsbooked.com/pricing.html): One plan, every feature — $99/mo locked in forever for the first 270 customers (+ usage-based AI/SMS). No annual contracts.
- [Use Cases](https://wattsbooked.com/use-cases.html): How WattsBooked solves real problems for solo electricians, office staff, multi-location contractors, and shop managers
- [Starting a Business](https://wattsbooked.com/new-business.html): The complete roadmap for starting an electrical business — licensing, registration, startup costs, pricing, getting your first customers, and the systems to run it
- [About](https://wattsbooked.com/about.html): Company background and mission
- [Blog](https://wattsbooked.com/resources/blog.html): Electrical business growth, AI, and operations content
- [Revenue Calculator](https://wattsbooked.com/resources/revenue-calculator.html): Estimate revenue impact of automation

## Who It's For

Electrical business owners, shop managers, electricians, and office staff at single-location and multi-location electrical contracting businesses in the United States.

## Core Capabilities

- **Voice AI**: Answers inbound calls 24/7, books jobs and estimates in real time, makes outbound callbacks within seconds of a form fill
- **Conversation AI**: Handles SMS, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and website chat in a unified inbox
- **CRM & Pipelines**: Customer records, lead stages, quote follow-up sequences, job history
- **Missed Call Text-Back**: Automatically texts every missed call within seconds
- **Email & SMS Campaigns**: Broadcast and automated nurture sequences
- **Online Booking**: Calendar and scheduling integrated with crew and technician availability
- **Reputation Management**: Automated review requests and monitoring
- **Membership Portal**: Service plans, maintenance agreements, and retention automations
- **Ad Manager**: Google and Facebook ad campaign management
- **Analytics**: Revenue attribution, campaign ROI, technician and job performance

## Pricing Summary

One plan: $99/month with every feature included, locked in forever for the first 270 customers. White-glove onboarding included.

Month-to-month, no annual contract. AI voice and messaging billed at usage rates (pennies per call/message).
